hint: To distribute, the outside number multiplies every term in the parentheses.

hints.title: 🪜 Try a simpler one
hints.text: Try $4(x + 5)$ first: it becomes $4x + 20$. In this problem the first term inside is $2x$ instead of $x$.
To distribute, the outside number multiplies every term in the parentheses.
Work out $4 \cdot 2x$ by multiplying $4$ and $2$ and keeping $x$. Then work out $4 \cdot 5$.

explanation: Distribute the $4$ to each term inside the parentheses.
The first product is $4 \cdot 2x = 8x$, which comes from $4 \times 2 = 8$.
The second product is $4 \cdot 5 = 20$, a plain number.
Adding the two products gives the answer $8x + 20$.
